assertions.text: [criterion-1] 45% (102,000/228,000) of Microsoft's full-time employees are located outside of the United States as of June 30, 2024.
assertions.evidence: The candidate states Microsoft had 228,000 full-time employees and 102,000 internationally, then calculates 102,000 / 228,000 = 44.7%, which supports the target 45% figure.

assertions.text: [criterion-2] 45% (102,000/228,000) of Microsoft's full-time employees are located outside of the United States as of June 30, 2024.
assertions.evidence: The candidate does not contradict the criterion; its calculation and conclusion are consistent with 45% (102,000/228,000) outside the U.S.
